_meta.description: Curated seed of active/recent U.S. class-action and regulatory settlements. Each record carries STRUCTURED eligibility criteria the matching engine can evaluate against a user profile. Always verify against the official settlement website before filing.
_meta.disclaimer: Informational only. Not legal advice. Deadlines and terms change; confirm on the official site.

settlements.title: Invitation Homes FTC Junk-Fee Refund
settlements.summary: FTC is mailing $47.2M to ~444,131 renters charged undisclosed/excessive fees. Automatic refund – no claim form required for most.

eligibility.label: Rented from Invitation Homes between Jan 2021 and Sep 2024

settlements.action_notes: Most eligible renters receive a check automatically. If you moved, update your address with the FTC refund administrator. Watch for a check; do not pay anyone to 'release' it.

settlements.title: Invitation Homes Minnesota Lease-Credit / Maintenance Settlement
settlements.summary: Covers MN renters who performed maintenance without compensation, 7/12/2015–7/12/2021. Members may elect debt relief or cash.

eligibility.label: Rented from Invitation Homes between Jul 12 2015 and Jul 12 2021

settlements.action_notes: Submit claim online or postmarked by 2026-02-10. Decide debt-relief vs. cash. Keep proof of tenancy and any maintenance you performed.

settlements.title: Cash App 'Invite Friends' Spam-Text (TCPA) Settlement
settlements.summary: $12.5M settlement for Washington consumers who received unsolicited Cash App invite texts over ~6 years. Est. $88–$147 per claimant.
settlements.action_notes: Claim window for this WA settlement has closed (2025-10-27). Logged for reference and to detect similar TCPA settlements you may qualify for next.

settlements.title: Generic TCPA Robotext / Robocall Settlements (Watchlist)
settlements.summary: Recurring settlements for unsolicited marketing texts/calls. New ones open regularly; this is a watch rule that flags you as a likely class member.
settlements.action_notes: Keep screenshots of spam texts with sender + date. They are evidence for TCPA claims ($500–$1,500 per willful violation in some cases).

settlements.title: Data-Breach Settlements (Watchlist)
settlements.summary: If your data was exposed in a breach (notified by letter/email), you are often a class member with cash + credit-monitoring options.
settlements.action_notes: Keep every breach-notification letter/email. Document any fraud, time spent, and out-of-pocket losses to claim the higher tier.
